One GraphQL query, graph(bookId), returns the whole book graph once (Hound: 837 nodes, 1,773 edges); the API caches it per book.
Hover: label, first chapter, name or text. Click: select (ring, neighbour dimming); one ring at a time; a click never opens the chat.
Every colour is a design-kit token read at runtime (--abp-fg, --abp-fg-muted, --abp-fg-faint, --abp-outline, --abp-accent).
